LEFT JOIN main.inventory_with_dims AS iv ON iv.product_id = pl.product_id AND iv.location_id = pl.location_id

ORDER BY pl.picklist_id, pl.line_no, g.log_time, iv.purchase_id

WITH target_products AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS order_qty
  FROM main.orderlines
  WHERE order_id = 421
  GROUP BY product_id
), inv AS (
  SELECT iv.product_id, iv.purchase_id, iv.purchased, COUNT(*) AS locations, SUM(iv.qty) AS stocked
  FROM main.inventory_with_dims AS iv
  JOIN target_products AS t ON t.product_id = iv.product_id
  GROUP BY iv.product_id, iv.purchase_id, iv.purchased
), picked AS (
  SELECT pl.product_id, iv.purchase_id, COUNT(*) AS pick_lines, SUM(pl.qty) AS picked
  FROM main.picking_line AS pl
  JOIN main.inventory_with_dims AS iv ON iv.product_id = pl.product_id AND iv.location_id = pl.location_id
  WHERE pl.order_id = 421
  GROUP BY pl.product_id, iv.purchase_id
)
SELECT t.product_id, t.order_qty, inv.purchase_id, inv.purchased, inv.locations, inv.stocked, picked.pick_lines, picked.picked
FROM target_products AS t
JOIN inv ON inv.product_id = t.product_id
LEFT JOIN picked ON picked.product_id = inv.product_id AND picked.purchase_id = inv.purchase_id
ORDER BY t.product_id, inv.purchased, inv.purchase_id

arguments.sql:
WITH order_demand AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS ordered_qty
    FROM main.orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 421
    GROUP BY product_id
),
stock_by_purchase_date AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, i.purchased, SUM(i.qty) AS stocked_qty
    FROM main.inventory_with_dims AS i
    JOIN order_demand AS d ON d.product_id = i.product_id
    GROUP BY i.product_id, i.purchased
),
fifo_stock AS (
    SELECT product_id, purchased,
           COALESCE(SUM(stocked_qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY product_id
               ORDER BY purchased
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
           ), 0) AS older_stock_qty
    FROM stock_by_purchase_date
)
SELECT pl.product_id, AVG(pl.qty) AS avg_units_picked
FROM main.picking_line AS pl
JOIN order_demand AS d ON d.product_id = pl.product_id
WHERE pl.order_id = 421
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.inventory_with_dims AS i
      JOIN fifo_stock AS f
        ON f.product_id = i.product_id AND f.purchased = i.purchased
      WHERE i.product_id = pl.product_id
        AND i.location_id = pl.location_id
        AND f.older_stock_qty < d.ordered_qty
  )
GROUP BY pl.product_id
ORDER BY pl.product_id
